title: review follow-ups of PR #37707: automation skill never says a pending record can be deleted; lockRecord row lost its "from edits" bound; stale changeset wording
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (Contract review records 7204561928 and 7204862503 on PR #37707, nits N4, N5 and the round-2 notes, adopted at ACCEPT)

## What happens

PR #37707 (Fixes #37529) teaches the three data-model publish checks of #35143's Data model family in the `objectstack-data` and `objectstack-automation` skills. Its review left these items open; none can be fixed on that head without moving it.

- [ ] **A pending record can be deleted, and the skill never says so** (round-2 note). `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` teaches the approval lock as refusing edits, but deleting a pending record is not refused: the delete lands, cancels the request and cascades its `master_detail` lines (`bindRecordDeleteCancelHook`). This is by design and untaught on `main` as well. Expected: one sentence beside best practice 2 or "Reading the lock".
- [ ] **The `lockRecord` row no longer states the lock's bound** (N5). "from edits" was cut to pay back tokens; it was the exact reach of the record's own lock (a `beforeUpdate` hook). Expected: restore the bound when the file has headroom.
- [ ] **Redundant arm in best practice 2** (N4). "or a parent field group" never applies on its own to a `lookup` child: a group places a lookup only when it is already `relatedList: 'primary'`. Expected: drop or qualify the arm.
- [ ] **The changeset still carries round-1 wording** (round-2 note). `.changeset/37529-skills-data-model-publish-checks.md` still says "drawn as a body table" and states the roll-up refusal unconditionally. Expected: reword before the changeset is consumed at release.

Category ①: skill text that leaves out or over-states shipped approval-lock behaviour.
Priority: p2 (security-touching text: it teaches what the approval lock refuses).
Business reason: an app author reading the skill believes a pending record is fully frozen, when it can be deleted and its approval cancelled.
Reader: the dev who next edits the automation skill's approvals reference.
Dedupe: searched open issues for `"PR #37707"`: only #37529 itself.
Related: #37529, PR #37707, #35143.

## Grade

area:ai · Bug · minor · reach: read (the head against `main`) · evidence: read → p2
